transcription.text: We must be careful with fire.
1. Fire can burn down a lot of trees.
We must be careful with fire.
2. Children, what do you know about fire safety?
What mustn't we do in the forest or at home?
We mustn't smoke in the forest.
We mustn't play near fires at home.
We mustn't play with matches at home.
Yas, the meat and the fire.
I live in the Stone Age.
Fire gives us heat and light.
My parents and my sister like meat, but I hate it.
It does not taste good at all.
3. I do not want to eat any meat, so I throw it into the fire.
4. Now the meat smells very nice.
5. We eat the meat. It tastes great.
After that, we cook all our meat on the fire.
When you see a fire, quickly go outside, but never use the lift.
If it is unsmokey, cover your mouth and nose and crawl out very fast.
Never stop for toys or clothes.
Now you are outside. You know what to do.
Listen to the firemen. Here they are to help you.
